contention_condition: prelaunch exclusivity is an observation, not dedicated hardware isolation; unrelated GPU/device contention remains possible
functional_scope: Only the canonical bilingual arithmetic and read-only loopback browser cases at three lengths, including every saved warmup, measured and endurance attempt; no general Agent or multimodal quality inferred.
instrumentation_scope: Private streaming prompt/raw capture adds synchronous I/O and separate instrumentation memory outside the 2 MiB consumer workspace; no whole-profiler memory bound.
native_compute_scope: Loaded CPU+CUDA configuration and routed decode expert counters only; no whole-operator placement claim.
native_io_scope: Native intervals exclude loading and can include background work. Logical bytes and OS completed aligned direct bytes remain separate; neither is model-attributed physical SSD or NAND media traffic.
precision: GSQ-RCO Q2_0 mixed; lookup table IQ4_NL
request_timing_scope: Complete Agent submit-to-final wall time includes synchronous private streamed evidence capture. Validated-final visibility is separate from hidden model first SSE delta, model-only generation and Qt/render latency.

sampled_native_process_gpu.scope: Separate sampled lower bounds; nonlocal overlaps host RAM and must not be added to RSS. Loading and hard total peaks remain unknown.

source_snapshot_scope: Actual local working-tree bytes, including preserved unrelated dirty sources; not a clean-commit claim.
startup_scope: Separate actual NativeProfileBridge prepare for each class, including integrity hashing and controller setup; native loading GPU peak unknown.
